philosophy.heading: Technology se pehle problem samajhte hain.
philosophy.description: Every business works differently. That's why we don't give every business the same solution. We understand the problem first. Then we decide what technology can actually improve.

steps.title: Find the Problem
steps.body: Where are you losing time, customers, or opportunities?

steps.title: Design the Solution
steps.body: Website? Tool? Automation? Or a simple improvement?

steps.title: Tell Us
steps.body: What's difficult for you right now?

steps.title: Plan
steps.body: We'll decide on the right solution.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: We'll build the website, tool, or automation.

steps.title: Improve
steps.body: We'll improve it based on real usage.
